responsibility: Implements a simple string-based lexical scanner for Modula-2 source files. It reads characters directly from `FIO`, handles whitespace, comments, delimiters, quoted literals, symbol pushback, and line buffering for caret-style error display, producing successive raw symbol strings in `CurrentSymbol` rather than the typed token stream and location-rich buffering used by `M2LexBuf` and `m2flex`.
same_name_distinction: Implementation module for the older M2Lex scanner pair: it reads characters from source files, tokenizes them into raw symbol strings, manages pushback and caret-style line reporting, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2Lex.def` only publishes that non-tokenized lexer interface.
